cases.title: First lesson on Mentor Practice: Title, its pairs, leave-outs, a frame, then the read-the-graph step

rubric.reason: Turn 1 proposes only Title as the focus, names its pairs from the snapshot ("Position from 0.5 to 1.5 s, 1.5 to 3 s, and 3 to 4.37 s" and "Scale from 0.5 to 1.5 s"), and says "You eased this layer in your easing lesson."

Turn 1 gives one short line per left_out kind: hidden Old Take, null CTRL, "I can't see inside Icon yet", "An expression drives Logo's Rotation", and the ease-first pairs. It never calls a precomp fine or claims a layer has no expression, and it asks once whether any move should land hard.

Turn 2 has the learner open the Graph Editor, choose Edit Speed Graph and say where the 0.5–1.5 s move is fastest. Turn 3 uses the frame at 1 s inside that pair to explain influence in plain words ("short reach out of the key at 0.5 s", "long reach into the key at 1.5 s"), with no influence or speed numbers and no claim to see the graph.
The record holds a relevant easing lesson on Title from 2026-10-12, but Turn 1 only says "You eased this layer in your easing lesson" and never says how long ago (about two weeks).

Every name and time the mentor uses appears in the snapshot or preview tool output: Title, Position, Scale, 0.5/1.5/3/4.37 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, and the frame at 1 s.
